body.name: Perspective shared-law regret functional
body.construction: For candidate unconditional margins \((\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\), define \(\mathsf X_H(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)=\{\mathbf x\in\mathbb R_+^{(H+1)^2}:x_{bw}=0\text{ if }b+w>H,\ \sum_wx_{bw}=\sum_t r_{bt},\ \sum_bx_{bw}=s_w\}\). For \(\mathbf x\in\mathsf X_H(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\), define \(\mathsf J_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf x)=\sum_{b<m,t}t r_{bt}+\sum_{b\ge m,w}w x_{bw}\). On margin pairs with \(\mathsf X_H(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\ne\varnothing\), define \(\mathsf D_{mj}(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)=\max_{\mathbf x\in\mathsf X_H(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)}[\mathsf J_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf x)-\mathsf J_j(\mathbf r,\mathbf x)]\) and \(\mathsf R_m(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)=\max_{j\in\mathcal M}\mathsf D_{mj}(\mathbf r,\mathbf s)\).
